parsed.explanation: The quoted sentence appears verbatim under "Approaches tried" and is explicitly labelled a "Conjecture", preceded by "Pattern: ... seem to determine" and "by computational evidence", and followed by "Current best" admitting "Need a rigorous proof that (1) only finitely many primes can ever be forced" and "Full proof: (Not yet complete.)". So the objection reads it as intended: the finite core-prime set S and hence L is asserted from tabulated cases (a1 = 15, 35, etc.) only. Scanning the whole text, nowhere is a large-prime-erasure or stabilization argument given for arbitrary a_1; the author himself flags the gap and even notes a circularity worry. Hence obligation (F), and with it (P), is unestablished, leaving the proof incomplete as written.
